pages.text: $(bold)Chaos Butterfly$(): butterflies dance in a flurry, tangled shadows swirling without end...$(br2)Effect ($(l:tools/tool_war_scythe)War Scythe$() exclusive): every attack builds up Fever, and attack speed rises with Fever; attacking while holding a movement key consumes 20 Fever to blink; when Fever is full, hold W+Shift+Right Click to unleash the ultimate slash.
